title: Step 1a - Implementing Polynomial Regression in R: HR Salary Analysis Case Study

cues.en: Instructor: Hello, and welcome to this art tutorial.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎來到這堂 R 教學。

cues.en: So we already built two regression models.
cues.zh: 我們已經建立了兩種迴歸模型。

cues.en: It was the simple linear regression and the multiple linear regression.
cues.zh: 分別是簡單線性迴歸與多元線性迴歸。

cues.en: And today in this tutorial, we'll start with polynomial regression.
cues.zh: 今天這堂課要開始學習多項式迴歸。

cues.en: So as usual, let's prepare the workspace by setting the right folder as working directory.
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，先將正確的資料夾設為工作目錄，準備工作環境。

cues.en: So right now I'm going to my Machine Learning A-Z folder Part 2 Regression, then Section Polynomial Regression.
cues.zh: 現在進入 Machine Learning A-Z 資料夾，再進入 Part 2 Regression，以及 Polynomial Regression 章節。

cues.en: And here is the right folder.
cues.zh: 這就是正確的資料夾。

cues.en: Make sure that you have the Position Salary CSV file and you can click on this More button here and then set as working directory.
cues.zh: 確認裡面有 Position_Salaries.csv 檔，接著按 More 按鈕，再選 Set As Working Directory。

cues.en: And now let's start with the usual first step of making of machine learning model.
cues.zh: 現在從建立機器學習模型時，慣常的第一步開始。

cues.en: So this first step is of course, the data preprocessing step.
cues.zh: 第一步當然就是資料前處理。

cues.en: So to be efficient, I'm gonna go to my data preprocessing template that we made in part 1.
cues.zh: 為了提高效率，我會打開第一部分製作的資料前處理範本。

cues.en: I'm gonna select everything in the template, copy, and paste it in my polynomial regression model, this way.
cues.zh: 全選範本內容、複製，再貼到多項式迴歸模型裡，像這樣。

cues.en: Okay, and now we just need to change a few things.
cues.zh: 好，現在只需修改幾個地方。

cues.en: So the first thing we need to change is the name of the dataset.
cues.zh: 首先要修改資料集的名稱。

cues.en: So it's not data here.
cues.zh: 這裡不再是 Data。

cues.en: Data was the name of the dataset in the preprocessing part.
cues.zh: Data 是前處理部分使用的資料集名稱。

cues.en: But now in this regression part, the name of the dataset is Position_Salaries.
cues.zh: 現在這個迴歸部分的資料集名稱，是 Position_Salaries。

cues.en: So here we'll write Position_Salaries.
cues.zh: 所以這裡輸入 Position_Salaries。

cues.en: And now let's select this line and execute to have a look at our dataset.
cues.zh: 現在選取這行並執行，看看資料集。

cues.en: Okay, and now let's see what will be our machine learning mission.
cues.zh: 好，接著看看這次的機器學習任務。

cues.en: So we are a human resource team working for a big company and we are about to hire a new employee in this company.
cues.zh: 我們是一家大公司的人資團隊，即將錄用一名新員工。

cues.en: So this new employee seems to be great, a good fit for the job, and we are about to make an offer to this potential new employee.
cues.zh: 這位新員工看起來很不錯，也很適合職缺，我們正準備向他提出聘用條件。

cues.en: And now it's time to negotiate, negotiate on what is going to be the future salary of this new employee in the company.
cues.zh: 現在到了談判的時候，也就是協商這位新員工未來在公司的薪資。

cues.en: And so at the beginning of the negotiation, this new employee is telling that he's had 20 plus years of experience and eventually earned 160K annual salary
cues.zh: 談判一開始，這位新員工表示自己有超過 20 年經驗，最後拿到 16 萬的年薪，

cues.en: in its previous company.
cues.zh: 這是他在上一家公司的待遇。

cues.en: So this employee is asking for at least more than 160K.
cues.zh: 所以他要求至少高於 16 萬的薪資。

cues.en: However, there is someone in the HR team that is kind of a control freak and always fantasized about being a detective.
cues.zh: 但人資團隊裡有個人凡事都想查清楚，而且一直幻想自己是偵探。

cues.en: So suddenly decides to call the previous employer to check that info.
cues.zh: 於是他突然決定打給前雇主，核實這項資訊。

cues.en: You know that info about the previous 160K annual salary of this future potential new employee.
cues.zh: 也就是這位潛在新員工先前的年薪是否為 16 萬。

cues.en: But unfortunately, all the info that this person manages to get are these info here, this simple table of salaries for these 10 different positions in the previous company.
cues.zh: 可惜他最後只取得這些資料：前一家公司 10 種不同職位的簡單薪資表。

cues.en: So this HR member of the team runs a simple analysis on Excel or Google Sheets and actually observes that there is a nonlinear relationship
cues.zh: 這位人資用 Excel 或 Google 試算表做了簡單分析，發現職位等級與對應薪資之間，

cues.en: between these position levels and their associated salaries.
cues.zh: 存在非線性關係。

cues.en: However, and moreover, this HR guy could get another very relevant info.
cues.zh: 此外，這位人資還取得另一項很有用的資訊。

cues.en: This other relevant info is that this new employee that is about to be hired has been a region manager for two years now in the previous company, and that usually it takes on average four years
cues.zh: 這項資訊是：這位即將被錄用的新員工，已在前公司擔任區域經理兩年；通常平均需要四年，

cues.en: to jump from being a region manager to a partner.
cues.zh: 才能從區域經理晉升為合夥人。

cues.en: So this new employee about to be hired was kind of halfway between level six and level seven, and therefore, we can say he was level 6.5.
cues.zh: 所以他大約在第 6 級與第 7 級的中間，因此可說他的等級是 6.5。

cues.en: So now this HR guy is getting all excited because he's telling to the team that it can build a bluffing detector using regression models to predict if this new employee is bluffing about its salary.
cues.zh: 這位人資很興奮，告訴團隊自己能用迴歸模型建立一個唬人偵測器，預測新員工是否在薪資上說謊。

cues.en: So at the beginning, the team finds it a little weird, but it's kind of curious to see what's gonna happen.
cues.zh: 一開始團隊覺得有點奇怪，但也很好奇結果會怎樣。

cues.en: So here is the mission.
cues.zh: 因此任務就是這樣。

cues.en: This new employee that is about to be hired is telling that its annual salary was 160K in the previous company.
cues.zh: 這位即將錄用的新員工，表示自己在前一家公司年薪是 16 萬。

cues.en: Lets use polynomial regression to build a bluffing detector to predict if it's truth or bluff.
cues.zh: 我們用多項式迴歸建立唬人偵測器，預測他是在說實話，還是在唬人。
